name: Screensaver Overlay
description: Native Now Playing and doorbell overlays for Kiosk Satellite screensavers and Fotoo, with Music Assistant queue tracking, artwork retry and camera triggers.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show overlays on
settings.description: Choose whether Now Playing and doorbell overlays are shown on Kiosk Satellite's own screensavers, Fotoo, or both.

settings.title: Now Playing entity
settings.description: Choose the Home Assistant media_player entity followed by Kiosk Satellite, for example media_player.drivhus.

settings.title: Show while paused
settings.description: Keep the Now Playing card visible while playback is paused.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Place the card at the top, center, or bottom of the Kiosk Satellite / Fotoo screensaver.

settings.title: Edge offset
settings.description: Distance from the selected top or bottom edge. Increase this to avoid Fotoo's clock or other overlays.

settings.title: Now Playing width
settings.description: Width of the Now Playing card as a percentage of the screen. Use a smaller value to fit between screensaver widgets.

settings.title: Now Playing opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the Now Playing card. 100% is fully opaque.

settings.title: Show progress bar
settings.description: Show the current playback position as a progress bar when the media player exposes duration and position.

settings.title: Time labels
settings.description: Choose the time shown under the progress bar.

settings.title: Show playlist/source
settings.description: Show playlist/source when the media player or Music Assistant exposes a useful name.

settings.title: Show next track
settings.description: Show the next track if the media player exposes it, or use the optional entity below.

settings.title: Next track entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional Home Assistant sensor/text entity whose state contains the next track title.

settings.title: Trigger 1
settings.description: Primary trigger, for example a Frigate person occupancy binary_sensor.

settings.title: Trigger 2
settings.description: Secondary trigger, for example the Reolink visitor/ring-button binary_sensor. Either trigger shows the same camera.

settings.title: Doorbell camera entity
settings.description: Choose the Home Assistant camera entity whose entity_picture should be shown when the doorbell rings.

settings.title: Camera visibility
settings.description: Camera visibility. At 100% the camera window is rendered as a fully opaque RGB surface. Touches inside the camera rectangle are then consumed by the overlay; outside it they still reach Fotoo.

settings.title: Camera size
settings.description: Camera width as a percentage of the screen. Height follows the actual camera frame aspect ratio automatically.

settings.title: Camera position
settings.description: Vertical position of the camera overlay.

settings.title: Camera display time
settings.description: How long the camera overlay stays above Fotoo after a doorbell trigger.
